7697.title: Redundant validation on successful daemon RPC sends
7697.rootCauseOneLine: ServerConnection.sendMessage reparses responses already normalized by the command router, recursively copying large plugin JSON results again.

prReviews.topFinding: Targets the redundant success-response parse; linked branch and tests were not executed.

7697.proposedFix: Preserve router validation and skip redundant outgoing validation only for already validated successes; retain validation for failures and other messages.
7697.caveats: Synthetic transport-unit reproduction, not a live plugin request. Both full builds hit an unrelated missing plugin SDK dist failure. Open PR #7704 already links this issue.
